Companion Animal Travel Desk travel guidance for pet check-in

Aurelia Skyways expects every animal journey to begin with careful preparation. If your companion is traveling with you, please review the kennel, health, and acceptance rules before you reach the skyport. This guidance is meant to protect the animal, the cabin team, and your travel plans.

<<FACT F068>> Pack the crate so it is secure, clean, and easy to handle. A carrier that shifts, leaks, or lacks clear ventilation can delay acceptance, and that delay may force a harmful rebooking. Bring the original paperwork the desk requests, and keep it ready for inspection at the counter.

For reptiles, the health certificate must be current when you arrive. <<FACT F084>> If a document is incomplete, outdated, or missing a required signature, the animal may not be cleared for transport. Please verify the certificate before departure, since last-minute fixes are often impossible under airport pressure.

Large dogs need especially careful attention because crate fit and total load are reviewed together. <<FACT F063>> If you are uncertain whether your setup qualifies, choose a safer arrangement and contact the desk before you travel. Never assume a crate that looked acceptable elsewhere will be accepted here without review.

The cabin team monitors animals during flight, and that does not replace your duty to prepare them well beforehand. Keep food, water, labels, and contact details organized, and do not leave anything to chance. Elena Shah and Arjun Kowalski should receive the same check-in care as any other traveler with a pet, including clear handling instructions and prompt arrival at the desk. If Winnie is traveling, confirm every document and restraint point before you leave home.

If your plans change, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once so the staff can protect your booking and your pet's welfare. For urgent help with any companion animal travel concern, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk immediately.
